verdict.rationale: Gmail ships its own assistant, Gemini in Gmail. The docs show it summarizing long threads, acting on multiple emails such as deleting or labeling them, and proposing meeting times from Google Calendar availability, so it reaches both inbox and calendar. Nothing documents free-form questions across the whole inbox and calendar with grounded answers. Missing for 10: documented inbox-wide Q&A, cross-inbox "who said what / what's outstanding" queries, calendar question answering, citations or grounding of answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
